columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Timestamp when the incident was last updated

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Incident type description (e.g. SSH Login Attempt)

columns.name: Acknowledged
columns.description: Whether the incident has been acknowledged

columns.name: EventsCount
columns.description: Number of events in this incident

columns.name: Events
columns.description: Array of event timestamps in milliseconds

columns.name: FlockId
columns.description: Flock ID the incident belongs to

columns.name: FlockName
columns.description: Flock name the incident belongs to

columns.name: Host
columns.description: Device details object (name, IP, version, services)

columns.name: LocalTime
columns.description: Local time of the incident on the device

columns.name: Memo
columns.description: Canarytoken reminder describing where the token was placed

columns.name: RawEvent
columns.description: Array of detailed event log objects

columns.name: NodeId
columns.description: Node ID of the Canary or Canarytoken

columns.name: PreviouslySeenCount
columns.description: Number of times this source was previously seen

columns.name: SourceIP
columns.description: Source IP address of the attacker
